name: repreprep
description: Rep Rep Rep: hands-on lessons for the Model:Cycles, MicroFreak and Ableton Move

scripts.check: node scripts/step-ids.mjs --check && node scripts/check-course.mjs && node scripts/check-css.mjs
scripts.messages: wrangler d1 execute repreprep --remote --command "SELECT id, datetime(created_at/1000,'unixepoch') AS sent, reply_to, body FROM messages ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50"
scripts.test: npm run format:check && npm run check && node --test 'tests/unit/*.test.mjs' && astro build && node --test 'tests/site/*.test.mjs' 'tests/server/*.test.mjs' && playwright test
